authority: AutoReconAI Multi-Agent Financial Controller Tool Registry

tools.description: Calculates high-level 3-way reconciliation health metrics across Store Orders, Razorpay Settlements, and Bank Statements. Computes overall GMV, total gateway MDR fees, 18% GST, Section 194-O TDS deductions, net bank deposits, overall reconciliation match rate (%), and pre-formats the Master 5-Way Financial Recovery Summary table.

output_fields.total_store_orders: Total count of orders in store CSV
output_fields.total_gmv_inr: Gross Merchandise Value of captured orders
output_fields.total_gst_inr: Total 18% GST charged on MDR fees
output_fields.total_tds_inr: Total Section 194-O TDS withheld by gateway
output_fields.total_bank_deposited_inr: Total net cash deposited into bank account
output_fields.mismatch_categories: Dictionary of 5 mismatch categories with counts, sample order IDs, fee losses, and dispute GMV vs penalty splits
output_fields.financial_recovery_summary: Pre-calculated dictionary with current net bank cash, claimable MDR refunds, recoverable dispute GMV, non-refundable penalty loss, refund fee leakage, and final post-recovery net bank credit
output_fields.default_table_md: Pre-formatted Markdown string containing the Master 5-Way Financial Recovery & Mismatch Summary Table

tools.description: Audits captured settlement transactions against the active contracted SLA terms (from config.ini). Identifies orders where the gateway billed an MDR rate higher than the contracted rate (e.g. 2.59% or 2.79% vs contracted 2.10% MDR + 18% GST = 2.48% SLA). Strictly excludes dispute holds and customer refunds.

output_fields.contracted_sla_terms: Active SLA text (e.g. 2.10% Domestic MDR + 18.00% GST = 2.48% SLA)
output_fields.total_overcharged_orders: Count of orders billed above contracted SLA
output_fields.total_claimable_overcharge_inr: Total excess rupee amount claimable from Razorpay as billing refund
output_fields.discrepancy_details: Itemized list of overcharged orders with date, order_id, payment_id, settlement_utr, billed_amount, charged_fee, charged_tax, effective_charged_rate, contracted_fee, contracted_tax, and overcharge_amount
output_fields.default_table_md: Pre-formatted Markdown date-wise overcharges table with header SLA formula and bottom TOTALS summary row

tools.description: Generates a formal, ready-to-send Razorpay Merchant Dispute Claim Ticket email payload for overbilled transactions, containing merchant MID, total claimable refund amount, SLA breach terms, and itemized transaction evidence table.

order_ids.description: Optional list of specific Order IDs to include. If omitted, includes all overcharged orders.

reason.description: Dispute reason text (defaults to Gateway MDR SLA Overcharge)

output_fields.subject: Email subject line with batch order count
output_fields.disputed_orders: List of structured order proof objects

tools.description: Audits all customer bank chargeback dispute holds and escrow deductions (Edge Case 4). Strictly identifies bank dispute IDs (disp_xxxx), disputed order GMV on escrow hold, INR 500.00 dispute handling fee, INR 90.00 GST (18%), and total escrow debit. IMPORTANT: Upon winning a dispute with Proof of Delivery (PoD), ONLY the Disputed Order GMV (total_disputed_gmv_inr) is refunded back to the merchant's bank account; the Dispute Handling & Penalty Fee (total_dispute_penalty_inr) is a mandatory card scheme representation fee retained by Visa/Mastercard and is PERMANENTLY NON-REFUNDABLE.

output_fields.total_chargeback_orders: Count of orders under active chargeback dispute
output_fields.total_disputed_gmv_inr: Total original order GMV placed on hold in escrow (100% Recoverable upon winning dispute with PoD)
output_fields.total_dispute_penalty_inr: Total penalty fees charged by gateway (INR 500 fee + INR 90 GST per dispute, PERMANENTLY NON-REFUNDABLE)
output_fields.recoverable_upon_winning_inr: Disputed order GMV that is credited back to bank upon winning dispute with PoD
output_fields.permanent_penalty_loss_inr: Mandatory dispute handling fees that are permanently retained by card schemes even upon winning
output_fields.total_escrow_debit_inr: Total combined debit deducted from settlement (Disputed GMV + Penalties)
output_fields.defense_guidance: Official compliance guidance for submitting courier AWB tracking and tax invoice within 7 days
output_fields.chargeback_details: Itemized list of dispute records with date, order_id, customer_name, payment_id, settlement_utr, disputed_order_amount, dispute_fee, dispute_tax, total_penalty_fee, and total_escrow_debit
output_fields.default_table_md: Pre-formatted Markdown table of bank dispute holds with bottom summary row

tools.description: Audits voluntary customer refunds ONLY (Edge Case 3). Strictly excludes bank chargeback disputes (disp_xxxx). Categorizes refunds into (1) Orphan Refunds (ORD_PRIOR_ from prior billing periods) and (2) Same-Month / Intra-Period Customer Refunds (ORD_xxxx). Calculates non-reversed gateway MDR + 18% GST fee leakage (which is non-refundable per standard gateway merchant terms).

output_fields.total_refund_entries: Total count of voluntary customer refunds
output_fields.total_refund_gmv_inr: Total refunded GMV returned to customers
output_fields.total_fee_leakage_inr: Total unreversed MDR + GST transaction fees lost by merchant
output_fields.claimable_from_gateway_inr: 0.00 (Processing fees are permanently non-refundable on customer returns)
output_fields.refund_policy_note: Razorpay transaction fees and GST are non-refundable on processed refunds
output_fields.refund_details: List of refund entries with date, order_id, payment_id, refund_amount, retained_mdr_fee, retained_gst_tax, unreversed_fee_loss, and classification (Orphan vs Intra-Period)
output_fields.default_table_md: Pre-formatted Markdown refund fee loss table

tools.description: Performs a complete statutory dual-mode tax audit covering: (1) Direct Tax: Section 194-O Income Tax TDS withholding (1.00% on gross sales, Form 26AS), and (2) Indirect Tax: 18% GST Input Tax Credit (ITC, Table 4(A)(5) GSTR-3B). Automatically self-checks invoiced MDR fees against contracted SLA terms (from config.ini) to detect if invoiced GST ITC contains SLA overcharges, presenting a 3-way Billed vs Contracted vs Overcharge breakdown.

output_fields.is_tds_applicable: Boolean flag indicating if Section 194-O TDS is enabled in config.ini
output_fields.merchant_tax_profile: Merchant PAN, GSTIN, and statutory withholding policy
output_fields.total_input_gst_itc_inr: 18% Input GST paid on MDR (100% eligible Input Tax Credit)
output_fields.total_section_194o_tds_inr: Total 1% Section 194-O TDS withheld by gateway
output_fields.default_table_md: Pre-formatted Markdown dual-table statement (Table 1: Section 194-O TDS / Table 2: GST ITC)
output_fields.accounting_guidance: Official compliance instructions for Form 26AS advance tax reconciliation and GSTR-3B Table 4(A)(5) credit claims

tools.description: Performs a deep 3-way forensic lifecycle trace of a specific Order ID across all 3 ledgers: (1) Store Orders Ledger (customer name, gross GMV, order status, creation timestamp), (2) Razorpay Settlements Ledger (payment ID, billed amount, charged fee, GST, effective rate, net credit, UTR, dispute records, refund records), and (3) Bank Statement Ledger (deposit amount, credit date, narration, matched UTR).

order_id.description: The exact Order ID to trace (e.g. ORD_1016, ORD_1023, ORD_1036, ORD_PRIOR_901)

output_fields.store_order_ledger: Customer name, gross amount, order status, and creation date
output_fields.razorpay_settlement_ledger: Payment ID, billed amount, MDR fee, GST, effective rate, net credit, and settlement UTR
output_fields.bank_statement_ledger: Deposit credit amount, transaction date, narration, and UTR match status
output_fields.chargeback_dispute_details: Dispute ID, dispute handling fee, GST on fee, total escrow debit, and PoD action
output_fields.financial_audit_diagnosis: 5-way anomaly classification, SLA overcharge amount, escrow held amount, and recommended action

tools.description: Lists all anomalous or mismatched orders across the 3-way reconciliation pipeline, filtered by anomaly category: fee_overcharge (SLA rate breaches), dropped_webhook (payment captured in Razorpay but order left PENDING in store), orphan_refund (prior-period customer refund deductions), or missing_bank_credit (settled UTR not deposited in bank).

category.description: Filter by anomaly category: all, fee_overcharge, dropped_webhook, orphan_refund, or missing_bank_credit

output_fields.mismatches: List of mismatched order objects with order_id, payment_id, settlement_utr, billed_amount, charged_fee, charged_tax, store_status, and detailed anomaly descriptions
output_fields.default_table_md: Pre-formatted Markdown table listing all mismatched orders and required actions

tools.description: Performs a read-only, parameterized SQL query against Razorpay authentic Payment Gateway core database (payments table in store.db). Used to verify raw captured payment records, status, settlement UTR, and timestamps directly at the gateway database level.

filter_key.description: Optional column to filter on: order_id, payment_id, status, or settlement_utr

filter_value.description: Optional value to search for (e.g. ORD_1016, pay_P1016_1AB4F2, captured)

output_fields.authority: Razorpay Gateway Core Database (Read-Only Defense Active)
output_fields.total_records_in_db: Total row count in payments table
output_fields.returned_records_count: Count of records matching filter criteria
output_fields.records: List of raw database rows matching query
output_fields.note: Client-side merchant store tables (orders/cart/products) are private client data and cannot be queried directly from gateway DB

tools.description: Calculates standard Indian GST (18%) and total amount on any given base fee or transaction amount.

base_amount.description: Base MDR fee or transaction amount in INR (e.g. 15000.00)

tools.description: Searches official government tax portals (cbic-gst.gov.in, incometaxindia.gov.in, rbi.org.in, razorpay.com/docs) for recent circulars, Section 194-O TDS rules, and 18% GST regulations when the user asks for 'latest', 'current', 'recent updates', or official regulatory comparisons.

query.description: The regulatory search query (e.g. 'latest Section 194-O TDS rate for e-commerce', 'GST on payment gateway charges')

output_fields.retrieved_statutory_updates: Snippet excerpts from official portals if available
